sections.heading: A few things you might be wondering

items.q: What do you need for an estimate?
items.a: The top’s width and length, photographs, your preferred finish, any deadline, and whether backing and batting are supplied.
Contact the studio first. Longarm work generally needs the top, batting, and backing as separate layers; the required extra backing depends on the setup.
A date is confirmed only in your accepted proposal. Let us know about weddings, gifts, or show deadlines before booking.

items.q: How do I send a quilt?
items.a: Agree the delivery address and packing instructions with the studio before shipping. Include your name and project reference inside the package.
